text:
Harper: Uploaded the launch post draft -> https://drive.re/redwood/launch-alpha-qa. Need quick eyes on the hero latency claim + webinar CTA mapping. Thinking: public hero 'median ≈35ms' and a technical badge 'p95 <210ms'.
Nikhil: Checking. Are those numbers warm-cache + autoscaler off or representative of production burst?
Harper: Warm KV cache, autoscaler idle (steady load). We'll show cold-starts in the appendix and a separate Dedicated table.
Gina: Legal: p95 call needs reproducible steps and the hardware/config table. Avoid superlatives like "fastest".
Tom: I'll add a short bench snippet and link to logs. bench: `./bench --model redwood-large --seq 1024 --batch 1 --runs 200 --device a100 --cache warm` Logs: https://ci.re/redwood/launch-alpha-logs
Nikhil: GTM: lead with median in hero copy, include p95 in a tech sidebar. Also recommend a small footnote explaining request mix.
Gina: Legal will approve once appendix includes: GPU types, kernel flags, RNG seed, request mix CSV, and exact command lines. @Tom please paste the sample CSV and seed.
Tom: Added sample (10 rows) and RNG seed=2026 to the appendix. Also linked the harness: https://ci.re/redwood/bench-harness-alpha
Harper: Webinar CTA: split registrants into two nurture streams (product demo vs trial enablement). Tag flow: `launch-demo` and `launch-trial`. @Marcom-bot can you create routing and add UTM params `utm_campaign=launch_alpha`?
Marcom-bot: Routing created: form -> webinar-list; split by selected interest -> tag `launch-demo` or `launch-trial`; UTM appended: utm_campaign=launch_alpha; followups scheduled: day 1, day 5. Confirm to enable.
Harper: Enable it. Also want a small experiment: capture an extra hidden field `scale_hint` to route high-scale prospects to Sales EPD. Can Ops set that mapping?
Nikhil: I'll add a mapping rule: if org_size > 2000 or scale_hint=enterprise -> add tag `route-sales`.
Gina: Legal: quick pass on hero quote after we remove absolutes. Harper, scrub the CTO line to "in our tests" phrasing.
Harper: Edited the quote to avoid absolutes. Approved by me.
Gina: Legal OK once appendix link is in the live draft.
Tom: Appendix is live with commands, hardware table, prompt/request mix, RNG seed, and variance note.
Nikhil: Growth ready — I'll prep social copy and landing variants. Will QA UTMs.
Harper: Final publish planned tomorrow 10:45 PT. Locking the doc in 10m. Any last blockers?
Marcom-bot: Routing and tags enabled as requested.
Gina: All clear from legal.
Harper: Locking now. Thanks team! :rocket:
